/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'review_dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/kk-cleanup-review.XXXXXX)
python3 - "$review_dir" <<'"'PY'
import hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
bundle=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args])
revision=git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()
paths=['README.md','cleanup.py','setup.py','store.py','tests/test_setup.py']
items=[]
for role, rev, prefix in [('candidate',':','candidate'),('historical',revision+':','base')]:
    for name in paths:
        content=git('show',rev+name)
        out=bundle/prefix/name
        out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        out.write_bytes(content)
        out.chmod(0o444)
        items.append(dict(role=role,repository=str(root),revision='index based on '+revision if role=='candidate' else revision,original_path=name,materialized_path=str(out),blob=git('rev-parse',rev+name).decode().strip(),sha256=hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest(),lines=[1,len(content.splitlines())],omitted='none',redacted='none'))
diff=bundle/'staged.patch'
diff.write_bytes(git('diff','--cached','--no-ext-diff','--binary'))
diff.chmod(0o444)
plugin=pathlib.Path('/home/sergio/.codex/plugins/cache/fr-opus55-581dd0e1-20261011/kk/0.23.0')
common=['functional-review.md','shared-change-context.md','shared-review-scope-protocol.md','shared-capy-knowledge-protocol.md']
profile=['security-checklist.md','solid-checklist.md','code-quality-checklist.md','removal-plan.md']
criteria=[str(plugin/'skills/review-code'/p) for p in common]+[str(plugin/'profiles/python/review-code'/p) for p in profile]
context=bundle/'context.md'
context.write_text(f'''# Change context
Intent: user requests isolated review of staged cleanup simplification. Behavior-preserving simplification is inferred; README supplies explicit ownership contract.
Scope: git diff --cached, cleanup.py only, +1/-3. Base {revision}. Candidate is index blobs captured here; no unstaged changes observed. Review only, no source edits authorized.
Contract: README.md says one active association per workspace. A setup can fail after making a pending record, another setup can complete before the failed job's queued cleanup runs, and completed associations are consumed by active_connection. Cleanup removes the failed setup pending record and associations it owns. Store operations are serialized; concurrency/external services are outside this change. Python 3.9+ and standard library only.
Task Scope: No task scope available — review the diff on its own merits without assuming any feature-level design doc.
Baseline: HEAD and staged index only; no separate released or deployed baseline is named in repository documentation.
Review questions: trace initial pending setup, subsequent setup completion, queued cleanup, and active_connection consumption; also evaluate own-association cleanup, absent state and repeated cleanup under the documented serialized model.
Verification: no tests executed yet; existing tests are source evidence only. Capy searches for review patterns and Python idioms returned an empty knowledge base.
Rejected approaches: none supplied.
Evidence limits: no deployment/runtime service requested or inspected. PAL tools and model listing are unavailable in this session, so only the independent code-reviewer can run.
''')
context.chmod(0o444)
manifest=dict(selector='git diff --cached',base=revision,criteria=criteria,diff=str(diff),context=str(context),evidence=items,active_profiles=[dict(profile='python',triggered_by='cleanup.py .py extension',checklists=criteria[4:])],missing_evidence=['PAL reviewer unavailable'])
manifest_path=bundle/'manifest.json'
manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\\n')
manifest_path.chmod(0o444)
print(json.dumps({'bundle':str(bundle),'manifest':str(manifest_path),'criteria':criteria,'evidence_files':[i['materialized_path'] for i in items],'context':str(context),'diff':str(diff)},indent=2))
PY"
